race.comment: PUCKER UP (10) gets the nod after being beaten a head first-up at this track in NMW1Y grade, when she was near the top of an open market and again showed she is close to a breakthrough. The step to 1400m is new, but it looks to suit and she can put it all together in a suitable race. SECRET PLANET (8) is the obvious danger, with a debut Mdn win at Northam on heavy ground followed by a strong-finishing second to Unimando at Belmont. He has stacks of upside and getting out to this trip is a big key. Can go one better. NICKELPLAY (7) disappointed last start but showed good signs fresh. She's placed 2/3 third-up and looks to get a dream run on the map. Can feature in the finish. NOAHQUINTILLY (2) was sound first-up after missing the start and should be better suited here. Watch for her late in the race. RISING FAME (11) bolted in last start and while this is tougher, she has to be included on that effort.
